notes_for_editor: Only source is the tnlandforms.us Georgia list (one page). The brief's register numbers (BLL US 65210, GFC US 804) match the list, which prints them as BLL-65210 and gfc-804; the page's key calls the third column 'GFC number'. The list names the tower only 'pierce', the same as the county name, so the real tower name is unknown and the record name may be a placeholder. A reviewer could check the GFC number 804 against a Georgia Forestry Commission source. Two WebSearch calls found nothing about this tower. The Georgia Forestry Commission history page linked from the list timed out and the savannahnow.com 2006 article returned 403, so neither was read. A second Pierce County entry, bonneyman (GA369), is on the same list and is not this tower.
